color.$description: Core palette (v2): daylight and golden hour. Light mode is daylight: warm cream paper and espresso ink. Dark mode is golden hour: dusk browns lit by low amber sun. No blue. Raw values only: components use the semantic tokens in tokens/semantic/.

sand.$description: Warm neutrals, from midday light (0) to dusk (950).

0.$description: Pure white. Only for small details such as the switch knob.

25.$description: Daylight paper: cards, inputs, tab bar.

400.$description: Dry grass: secondary text at golden hour.

800.$description: Espresso ink: body text in daylight.

900.$description: Dusk surface: cards at golden hour.

950.$description: Dusk sky: page at golden hour.

100.$description: Honey wash: tinted backgrounds in daylight.

400.$description: Low amber sun: primary colour at golden hour.

500.$description: Sun gold: logo and app icon.

900.$description: Amber shadow: tinted backgrounds at golden hour.

ember.$description: Terracotta: sun on brick and clay.

600.$description: Terracotta: primary colour in daylight, app icon background.

rose.$description: Evening rose. Errors only, kept apart from the terracotta by hue.

dusk-alpha.$description: Warm, translucent shadow colour (dusk brown, not black).
